notes: The uarch program is built with asserts enabled (uarch/uarch-runtime.hpp: assert prints and calls abort, which is an ebreak, i.e. a uarch trap). The abort sites present in uarch-ram.elf are: assert_no_brk (5 conditions, after the interrupt check and after every instruction that returns success/failure/flush), assert(false) in get_highest_priority_irq_num, the mcycle assert at the end of interpret, the soft-float normalize/normalize2 asserts, do_read_pma for an unknown non-memory PMA, and device read_memory/write_memory. Every uarch run above would have thrown on any of them; none fired. By reading: stores propagate the device status in execute_S/FS/C_S/C_FS/SC/AMO; mip, mie and mideleg writes return serve-interrupts; mie/mip are legalized to the six standard bits; PTEs are read only from RAM.

send_cmio_response refuses (throws) an advance-state delivery that would take effect when the supplied revert root hash differs from the machine root hash, and any revert hash on a non-advance reason, while log_send_cmio_response accepts both. With the referee parameter of A4 (revert root hash = before-hash) neither fails; not reported as a candidate.
not_covered: The Solidity step (regenerated UArchStep/UArchReset/SendCmioResponse) and the Dave CartesiStateTransition were not run: only the C++ verify_step_uarch, verify_reset_uarch and verify_send_cmio_response (through Lua).
log_step/verify_step (main-processor step log) and the JSON-RPC interface were not used.

collect_mcycle_root_hashes only with period 2^0, phase 0 and no bundling; collect_uarch_cycle_root_hashes only with bundle size 2^0; collect_mcycle_bundle and collect_uarch_cycle_bundle not called. The hashes of the reverted period taken from revert_uarch_tail after a rejection were not checked beyond the reset entry.

log_step_uarch + verify_step_uarch covered only sampled windows of sampled mcycles (about 34,000 steps in the fuzzer, 35,298 in special.lua, about 3,400 on Linux); the other uarch cycles of sampled mcycles were compared by root hash only, and unsampled mcycles only after the reset.
Consistency across paths only: no independent RISC-V reference model, so a deviation from the specification that every path shares (R7) is invisible to these harnesses.
Sv57: satp writes with mode 10 were generated but the mode never became active in the runs; no Sv57 walk was exercised.

Each fuzz case runs at most 3000 mcycles and crosses at most one RTC tick; Linux windows are 1000 mcycles. Divergences that need long runs, many ticks, or rare kernel paths were sampled only by the 200 Linux windows.

PLIC sources can only be pending through the initial configuration (12% of fuzz cases); no device raises them in a reproducible machine. VirtIO, console input, soft yield and unreproducible machines were not exercised.

No store/load/clone/replace_memory_range between steps, no sha256 hash tree, no inspect-state deliveries; at most a handful of deliveries per case and no delivery on a machine restored after a rejection.

Only this host build (GCC 13.3, x86-64) and its ASan/UBSan variant; other compilers, optimization levels and hosts (R1) were not compared. The sanitizer build was used for 18 differential cases and 17.7M native mcycles only.
Worst-case uarch cycles per mcycle were only observed (maximum 20,388), not searched for.
The soft-float asserts compiled into the uarch were checked by magnitude arguments for add, mul, fma and the conversions and by fuzzing; div and sqrt only by fuzzing.
